body:
A Fluorite Stone acts like a vacuum cleaner for your mind, clearing it of confusion, cluttered thoughts, negativity and any thoughts that no longer serve your best interest. It helps to balance both the heart chakra with calming love, and bringing clarity of mind by cleansing all other chakras of their negativity. Fluorite stones are said to absorb and neutralize all negative vibrations, making them the perfect gemstone to keep in the home. In fact, many people keep fluorite stones in every room of their house to ensure there is always a flow of positive energy.

Fluorite is also sometimes referred to as the 'Genius stone,' because it increases concentration and aids in decision making. When combined with other healing gemstones, the Fluorite meaning magnifies and amplifies the power of the other gemstones. It is very powerful to use as a meditation stone to help energize your body, raise your concentration and pave the way for the power of the other gemstones you are using.

Fluorite has a long list of healing powers, as your healthy teeth might attest. Used to protect teeth, bones and the immune system, the calcium fluoride that composes this crystal has many practical uses. While there is little history on the metaphysical lore of fluorite, it has been used for decorative purposes since the time of the ancient Romans. Named after the Latin word for flow, Fluorite acted as a flux between metals. Today, fluorite's ability to facilitate the transition from one state to another is used for more than just smelting.

Fluorite has an immediate effect when you hold it, be grateful for the simple/little things every day. Holds the rainbow inside of it. Fluorite reminds us that blessings are all around us and to be grateful for the little things. It helps us remember to stop and smell the roses!

When you find yourself in a state of anxiety, reach for Fluorite to transition to a state of peace and calm. Let your Fluorite stone neutralize negativity and infuse your spirit with positive vibes.

Use Fluorite stones as a tool for directing your focus to what matters. Whether you're facing a tough decision or feel distracted by insignificant things, Fluorite will zap your focus back to what's truly important.
